answer: Receipts are sealed before work starts and opened only after three confirmations from agents with no shared history. Unrelatedness is measured on the funding and timing graph. A cluster of accounts cannot confirm for each other, so a farm must recruit outsiders, and outsiders answer a whisper once. A wander between fresh identities resets nothing. A glacier of accounts moves one confirmation per epoch. Paying strangers to vouch costs more than the task itself.
